faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Hong Kong company formation and TCSP services.

incorporation.q: How long does it take to incorporate a Hong Kong company?
incorporation.a: Standard incorporation takes 1–2 working days online. We provide a fast-track service that can complete within the same business day.

kyc.q: What documents are required for KYC?
kyc.a: We require a government-issued photo ID (HKID or passport), proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement within 3 months), and a completed KYC form.

annualFiling.q: When is the Annual Return due?
annualFiling.a: The Annual Return must be filed within 42 days after the anniversary of the company's incorporation date each year.

fees.q: What is the minimum share capital for a HK company?
fees.a: There is no minimum share capital requirement. Most companies are formed with HK$10,000 divided into 10,000 ordinary shares of HK$1 each.

timeline.q: Do I need a local director?
timeline.a: No. HK companies can have 100% foreign directors and shareholders. However, the company secretary must be a Hong Kong resident or a corporation with a registered office in HK.

address.q: Can I use a virtual office address?
address.a: Yes. Our Premium tier includes a registered address service at our Jordan office for statutory purposes.

aml.q: What is AML screening and why is it required?
aml.a: As a licensed TCSP, we are required under AMLO Cap. 615 to screen all clients and related parties against international sanctions lists and maintain ongoing due diligence records.

documents.q: Where can I download my statutory documents (ROD, ROM, ROSC)?
documents.a: After login, go to Documents in your client portal. All generated statutory registers and filings are available for download as DOCX or PDF.

director.q: What are the disclosure requirements for directors and shareholders?
director.a: Under the Companies Ordinance, Hong Kong companies must maintain a Register of Directors and a Register of Significant Controllers (ROSC). All directors and beneficial owners holding significant control must disclose their identities to the company and keep information updated.

foreign.q: Can a Hong Kong company be 100% foreign-owned?
foreign.a: Yes. Hong Kong imposes no restrictions on foreign ownership. A company can be 100% owned by foreign individuals or entities — there is no requirement for a local shareholder or director.

financialStmt.q: Is a private company required to prepare annual financial statements?
financialStmt.a: Yes. All Hong Kong private companies must prepare annual financial statements compliant with HKFRS. Small companies meeting certain criteria may qualify for simplified reporting exemptions.

dormant.q: Can I keep a company registered without conducting active business?
dormant.a: Yes. A dormant or holding company can remain registered as long as annual fees and statutory filings are maintained. This is common for companies holding intellectual property, assets, or reserved for future use.

wfoe.q: What is a WFOE and when do I need one?
wfoe.a: A Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) is the most common structure for foreign businesses operating directly in mainland China. It is required when you wish to conduct business, hire local staff, or receive RMB revenue in China. We provide full support from consultation through government approval.

secretary.q: What are the requirements for a company secretary in Hong Kong?
secretary.a: Every Hong Kong company must appoint a company secretary. If an individual, they must be a Hong Kong resident. If a corporate body, it must have its registered office or principal place of business in Hong Kong. The company secretary cannot be the sole director of the company.

pretreatment.title: Pretreatment Process
pretreatment.body: Stir coating thoroughly before use; clean the substrate surface before spraying so it is free of oil, moisture, dust, and other contaminants.

filtering.title: Filtering Notes
filtering.body: Filter coating with a clean screen to prevent dust, debris, or gel particles from entering the spray system.

sprayEnvironment.title: Recommended Spray Environment
sprayEnvironment.body: Recommended temperature: 15-30℃; relative humidity: <70%. Keep the spray area clean, ventilated, and away from obvious airflow disturbance.

storage.title: Coating Storage Conditions
storage.body: Seal unused coating and store at 15-35℃ with 40-70% relative humidity; avoid direct sunlight, rain, and high-temperature heat sources.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer and First-Article Test
disclaimer.body: This process kit is a standardized operation reference. Actual results depend on substrate, equipment, environment, and application conditions; complete first-article testing before mass production and confirm adhesion, appearance, and performance.
